settings.html: Know the signs

settings.title: Keep Your Home Cool, Comfortable, and Efficient

settings.editor: Your air conditioner is one of the most important systems in your home during the summer. When it is not working properly, comfort problems can show up fast.
Lenz Heating & Cooling helps Des Moines and Central Iowa homeowners find practical cooling solutions that restore comfort, improve efficiency, and protect long-term HVAC performance.
Call Lenz Heating & Cooling if you notice:

settings.html:
• Warm air coming from your vents
  • Weak airflow or uneven cooling
  • AC running constantly without reaching the set temperature
  • High summer utility bills
  • Frequent short cycling
  • Strange noises or odors
  • Water leaking near the indoor unit
  • Ice on coils or refrigerant lines
  • Humid indoor air even when the AC is running
  • An older AC system that needs frequent repairs
  • A system that will not turn on

settings.html: Cooling services

settings.editor:
When your air conditioner stops cooling, starts making unusual noises, leaks water, freezes up, or struggles to keep up, AC repair may be the right solution.

AC repair is often the best starting point when your system is newer, the problem appeared suddenly, or the repair cost makes more sense than replacing the entire unit. Our technicians inspect the system carefully, explain what is causing the issue, and recommend the repair that best fits your home and equipment.

Common air conditioner repair issues include warm air from vents, frozen coils, weak airflow, thermostat problems, electrical issues, refrigerant concerns, and outdoor unit failures.

Prompt AC repair can help prevent minor problems from turning into major breakdowns during peak summer heat.

settings.html: Explore AC Repair

settings.editor:
A properly installed air conditioner can make a major difference in comfort, efficiency, humidity control, and long-term reliability. If you are building a home, adding central air, replacing outdated equipment, or upgrading your cooling system, Lenz Heating & Cooling can help you choose a system that fits your home’s size, layout, and comfort needs.

System sizing matters. An oversized air conditioner may cool too quickly without removing enough humidity, leaving your home feeling damp or sticky. An undersized system may run constantly and still struggle to keep up on hot Central Iowa afternoons.

Our team installs quality cooling systems designed to perform well through Des Moines summers.

settings.html: Explore AC Installation

settings.editor: Proper AC installation helps ensure:

settings.html:
• Correct system sizing
  • Reliable cooling performance
  • Better humidity control
  • More efficient operation
  • Fewer comfort issues after installation

settings.editor:
If your air conditioner is older, inefficient, or becoming expensive to repair, AC replacement may be the better long-term investment.

Replacing an aging cooling system can improve comfort, reduce repair stress, and help lower long-term operating costs. A professional evaluation can also help you compare repair versus replacement so you are not guessing or making a rushed decision during a breakdown.

settings.html: Explore AC Replacement

settings.editor: Replacement may be worth considering if:

settings.html:
• Your system is 10 to 15 years old or older
  • Repairs are becoming frequent
  • Energy bills keep rising
  • Your home has uneven cooling
  • The system still uses outdated refrigerant
  • Your AC struggles during hot weather
  • Repair costs are getting close to the cost of replacement

settings.editor:
Preventative AC maintenance helps your cooling system run efficiently and reduces the risk of surprise breakdowns.

AC maintenance is especially important before summer, when your system is about to run longer and work harder. During a maintenance visit, technicians can inspect system performance, check airflow, evaluate electrical components, clean key parts, and identify early signs of wear.

If your AC is working but seems louder, weaker, or less efficient than it used to be, maintenance may be the right first step.

settings.html: Explore AC Maintenance

settings.editor: Routine maintenance can help:

settings.html:
• Improve cooling efficiency
  • Reduce the risk of emergency AC repairs
  • Extend system lifespan
  • Support better airflow
  • Catch small problems before they become expensive repairs

settings.editor:
Cooling problems do not always happen at a convenient time. If your AC stops working during extreme heat or your home becomes uncomfortable quickly, Lenz Heating & Cooling provides emergency HVAC service to help restore comfort.

Emergency service is especially important for households with young children, older adults, health concerns, or anyone who may be more vulnerable to high indoor temperatures. Our goal is to help you get clear answers and dependable service when comfort and safety cannot wait.

settings.title: Why Cooling Services Matter for Home Comfort

settings.editor: Your cooling system affects more than the temperature on your thermostat. When the system is properly installed, maintained, and repaired when needed, your home feels better and your HVAC equipment works more efficiently. Investing in professional cooling services can help improve:

image.alt: A family relaxing in a comfortable Des Moines home

settings.editor: Reliable cooling helps keep bedrooms, upstairs spaces, finished basements, and main living areas more consistent during humid Central Iowa weather.
A clean, properly operating system uses less energy and can help keep summer utility bills under control.
Timely repairs and regular maintenance reduce unnecessary strain on major components, helping your AC last longer.
Better airflow, filtration, and humidity control can help reduce dust, stale air, and indoor discomfort.
When your AC is inspected and serviced by a professional, you can feel more confident heading into the hottest months of the year.
